candidate_definition.normalizers: frozen TRAIN_C5_24 input mean/std and target_rms only
candidate_definition.score_stage: before beta ramp; base network only; no causal-head adaptation

fixed_zero_compensation_baseline.interpretation: no learned residual compensation; compare zero prediction against the exact same fixed-J0 physical residual labels

metrics.axis_pooled_rmse: sqrt(mean(error(scene,event,axis)^2 over all events and scenes))
metrics.axis_scene_macro_rmse: mean over scenes of sqrt(mean(error(scene,event,axis)^2 over events))
metrics.wind_group_metrics: same formulas restricted to scenes whose locked scene_id suffix is W00..W15
metrics.per_scene_metrics: per-axis pooled event RMSE and overall scene event-axis RMSE
metrics.distributions: mean,std,RMS,min,max,p01,p50,p99 for targets, raw outputs, clipped outputs by axis
metrics.clip_counts: count and fraction of raw candidate predictions outside fixed dmax; zero baseline is never clipped

use_boundary: single diagnostic only; no checkpoint/model selection, threshold choice, normalization changes, hyperparameter changes, or code changes based on VAL result
prior_comparator_disclosure: legacy full72 checkpoint fit included C5_VAL48; not a fair independent-validation comparator.
